summary: This Form 8-K is a routine distribution notice for CorTS Trust for PECO Energy Capital Trust III, an asset-backed securities trust. The filing reports a $1.00 per $25 certificate interest distribution on April 30, 2026, with no principal payment. It does not involve any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The document is purely an administrative report fulfilling Exchange Act requirements, not a special situation event.
